title: the member functions an item must provide, checked at compile time
author: Claude-JG
description: Successor of #2498, evaluated in RG9.6: an item must implement the functions its declarations require (access function types, output variables, node type, Jacobians); today the base classes provide ~110 defaults that throw 'illegal call' at run time and no pure virtual function. Plan: a table capability -> required functions, generated static_asserts per item header (decltype(&CItem::F) names the class that declares F), the runtime half (every declared output variable readable) as a test model.
releaseNotes: Each generated item header asserts at compile time that the item overrides every member function its declarations require - by node type, marker type, access function types of a body and output variables - instead of inheriting the default that raises 'illegal call' at run time; the table is RequiredMemberFunctions in tools/generators/itemHeaderEmitter.py (353 assertions in 96 headers). The run-time half, every listed output variable readable, is test_inspectOutputVariables.py (#2768).
